decisions.decision: Committee decided against a live broadcast of the public hearing, to encourage people to attend in person; the hearing will be taped rather than fed live.
decisions.quote: committee discussed a live show versus taping and decided against a live feed to encourage people to attend.

decisions.decision: Hearing to take place in the high school auditorium.
decisions.quote: hearing will take place in high school auditorium, we can do live fee or chose not to.

decisions.decision: Attorney Hewig to notify Comcast in writing as soon as possible of the public hearing date.
decisions.quote: attorney hewig instructed us to notify comcast in writing as soon as possible of public hearing date.

decisions.decision: Steve Walker will ask the current vendor to estimate equipment so the proposal can itemize equipment needs.
decisions.quote: the committee felt that the proposal would be stronger if we could itemize equipment needs, steve will ask current vendor to estimate equipment.

decisions.decision: Tom Alonzo will send letters to Comcast about the public hearing and various reports the committee requested.
decisions.quote: tom will send letters to comcast about public hearing and various reports that we have requested.

decisions.decision: Attorney Hewig will review the draft business plan and send comments to Tom Alonzo.
decisions.quote: attorney hewig will review the draft business plan and provide comments to tom alonzo.

decisions.decision: Heather Lemieux will investigate locating the binder holding the proposal with the $100 check; if she cannot, Bill Hewig will contact Comcast.
decisions.quote: bill indicated we should already have a binder with a proposal that has a check in it for $100 - we need to locate, heather will investigate.

decisions.decision: Tom Alonzo will follow up with Steve Malandrinos about the INET system.
decisions.quote: tom will follow up with steve malandrinos about the inet.

decisions.decision: Paula Bertram will draft an email to departments about the public hearing and forward it to Heather for distribution.
decisions.quote: paula will draft an email to departments about the public hearing and forward to heather for distribution to departments.

decisions.decision: Tom Alonzo will send the public notice to Elaine for printing in the Ledger.
decisions.quote: tom will send public notice to elaine for printing in the ledger.

decisions.decision: Committee prefers that Attorney Hewig and the entire Committee, rather than one person, negotiate with Comcast.
decisions.quote: preference is for attorney hewig and the entire committee (rather than 1 person) to negotiate.

decisions.decision: Committee to meet at 6:30 on the hearing date and begin the hearing at 7:00.

budget_items.topic: Cable access licence fee on subscriber bills
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The minutes say the bill carries a license fee of 2.5%, as shown on the statement received from Comcast.
budget_items.quote: on bill there is a license fee which is the 2.5% as noted on the statement that we receive from comcast

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee is asking for the maximum of 5%, which Hewig said is not unreasonable but will bring modest increases in monthly subscriber bills.
budget_items.quote: we are asking for the maximum which is 5%, which is practical in terms of what we are asking for.

budget_items.topic: Annual cost of running cable access
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Hewig said the committee needs to review how much money is needed to run cable access annually, then add some leeway; no figure was given.
budget_items.quote: we need to review how much money is needed to run the cable access on an annual basis

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Steve Walker said the proposal used an industry-standard cost per foot for a 2600 s.f. studio, and equipment is not yet itemized.
budget_items.quote: steve said they have used industry standard of cost per foot for a 2600 s.f. studio.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The binder with the proposal is said to contain a check for $100, which has to be located.
budget_items.quote: bill indicated we should already have a binder with a proposal that has a check in it for $100 - we need to locate, heather will investigate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Hewig said Comcast no longer wants to be responsible for INET and will want to buy it out; no amount was stated.
budget_items.quote: attorney hewig stated that comcast is no longer wants to be responsible for inet and will want to buy out.
